skill.summary: Best practices for Remotion - Video creation in React

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Remotion Best Practices skill.

- Provides domain-specific guidance for Remotion, video creation in React.
- Outlines when to use this skill and how to access detailed rules.
- Includes links to individual rule files covering topics like animation, assets, audio, subtitles, trimming, transitions, AI voiceover, maps, and more.
- Offers direction for working with FFmpeg, captions, audio visualization, and sound effects in Remotion projects.
